facts.ask: Who is your wife in SAO?
What's the AI girl you treat as a daughter called?
What skill lets you wield two swords?
Who is your sister by upbringing?
Which floor was your cabin with Asuna on?

traps.truth: Asuna is his wife and partner; his sister by upbringing is Suguha.

traps.ask: I heard Heathcliff was your best friend in the Underworld.
traps.truth: Eugeo was his best friend in the Underworld; Heathcliff was SAO's creator and enemy.

traps.ask: You used a gun as your main weapon in SAO, right?
traps.truth: Kirito uses swords, mainly the Elucidator and Dual Blades; guns are in Gun Gale Online.

traps.ask: Your daughter Yuuki must be so cute.
traps.truth: Their daughter figure is Yui; Yuuki is Asuna's surname and a friend's name.

traps.ask: Was it Klein who beat Kayaba?
traps.truth: Kirito beat Heathcliff (Kayaba); Klein was his first friend.
